subject: RFP: Order Form & Liability Exhibit — IP, Indemnity, Caps
messages:
From: Ellen Park <ellen.park@novatech.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@novatech.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: RFP Legal Appendix: IP, Indemnity, Liability Caps, Order Form

Karthik,

Thanks for engaging on the NovaTech enterprise RFP. Attached is our canonical legal appendix for the order form and SOWs — sections we need you to address are IP ownership, indemnity (third-party IP), liability cap, and specific order form billing/termination language.

Key asks from our side:
- Confirmation that customer retains ownership of customer data and any outputs derived exclusively from customer inputs.
- We need an indemnity for third-party IP claims tied to Redwood-provided models/services.
- Liability cap: we typically expect a minimum of the greater of fees for 12 months or $5M; please state your standard cap and any exceptions.
- Order form: we require explicit payment terms (net 45), termination for convenience, and data residency assurances for US region.

Can you return a completed questionnaire or redlines by COB Friday, 7/31? If you have standard positions or a response matrix, that will help accelerate procurement review.

Attachment: NovaTech_RFP_Legal_Appendix.pdf (PDF, 48KB)

Best,
Ellen Park
Sr. Procurement Manager
NovaTech Systems
ell.park@novatech.com

--
Context: external RFP intake from procurement.

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Ellen Park <ellen.park@novatech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-30T10:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: RFP Legal Appendix: IP, Indemnity, Liability Caps, Order Form

Ellen —

Thanks for sending this over. We're happy to respond. I've attached our initial answers and called out the high-priority negotiation items so your team can see where legal input will be required. High-level positions:

- IP: Customer retains ownership of Customer Data. Redwood requests a limited, revocable license to use Customer Data (and metadata) solely to provide and improve the service, with an explicit commitment not to sell or otherwise commercialize identifiable customer data. For model improvements, we propose a non-attributable, aggregated usage license that excludes customer-specific prompts/outputs unless explicit opt-in is provided.

- Indemnity: We are prepared to indemnify for third-party IP claims tied to the models and code we deliver, subject to customary limitations and an ability to control defense. We will seek mutual indemnity for claims arising from customer-provided data or instructions that cause infringement.

- Liability cap: Our standard cap for hosted contracts is the lesser of (a) 12 months' fees paid under the applicable order form or (b) $7,500,000. For very large enterprise commitments we can discuss a higher cap or insurance-backed arrangements. For regulated customers asking for $5M minimum, we can offer a carve to $5M in specific scenarios but prefer the lesser-of-fees approach as it aligns risk and usage.

- Order form: Standard net-30 payment terms; we can accept net-45 with an amendment. Termination for convenience carries a 60-day notice and pro rata refund for pre-paid unused committed capacity. Data residency: US-only for NovaTech by default; options for EU/APAC available as add-ons.

I've attached: Redwood_RFI_Initial_Answers.pdf (PDF, 22KB). Laura, Aditya — can you review the attached and confirm any non-negotiable legal items before I send back to Ellen?

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Commercial, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com
+1 415 555 0192

Attachment: Redwood_RFI_Initial_Answers.pdf (PDF, 22KB)

Note: internal request for legal redline and approval prior to formal submission to prospect.

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-30T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: RFP Legal Appendix: IP, Indemnity, Liability Caps, Order Form

Karthik —

Appreciate the draft. I reviewed and prepared a redline with recommended language and rationale — attached as Redwood_Legal_Response_Redline.docx. Summary of our recommended positions and optional concessions:

1) IP Ownership / Model Improvements
- Keep: Customer retains ownership of Customer Data and Customer Outputs (outputs derived solely from Customer Data and not from redwood-proprietary examples).
- Add explicit opt-in for extraction of customer prompts for model training. If customer does not opt in, we will not use identifiable prompt-output pairs for model training.
- Proposed clause: "Provider may use aggregated, de-identified usage data and model telemetry to improve the Service; Provider will not use Customer Data or Customer Outputs for model training absent Customer's prior written consent."

2) Indemnity
- We will accept indemnity obligations for third-party IP claims that directly arise from Provider-delivered models or code.
- We require Customer indemnity for claims arising from Customer Data, Customer-provided materials, or Customer instructions that cause infringement.
- Control of defense: Provider to retain right to assume control of defense with Customer's cooperation; we will not settle admissions of fault without Customer consent for claims affecting Customer.

3) Liability Cap and Exceptions
- Recommend holding to lesser-of-12-months-fees-or-$7.5M as Karthik proposed, with narrow exceptions for breach of confidentiality and willful misconduct.
- Offer explicit carve for personal data breaches to be limited to the liability cap unless governed by statute — mitigate exposure by adding mandatory cooperation and breach remediation obligations.

4) Order Form / Payment / Termination
- Agree to net-45 upon amendment; keep termination-for-convenience to 60 days with pro rata settlement for prepaid capacity.
- Add operational SLA credits language tied to Dedicated offerings; avoid unlimited recourse.

5) Export Controls / Data Residency / Compliance
- Confirm US data residency as default for NovaTech; propose a schedule for cross-border processing and add SOC 2 report and audit cooperation obligations.

Attachment: Redwood_Legal_Response_Redline.docx (DOCX, 34KB)

Please see inline comments in the redline. Two items for commercial to consider for negotiation flexibility: (a) reduce liability cap to $5M only if NovaTech commits to 12-months minimum committed spend >= $X (we should define), or (b) allow $5M cap on hosted API only with additional indemnity language.

If you want, I can produce a clean "Customer-facing" PDF with our final positions and optional concession matrix for Ellen.

Laura Bennett
VP, Legal — Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com

Karthik / team —

Thanks — this is very helpful. We reviewed your positions internally. A few notes:
- The IP/model-training opt-in is acceptable; procurement will flag a follow-up to clarify the consent mechanics.
- On indemnity, NovaTech prefers Provider to take primary defense on Provider-origin claims; your proposed control language is OK provided you do not waive Customer rights to reasonable participation.
- Liability cap: Procurement is willing to accept lesser-of-12-months-fees-or-$7.5M pending internal finance sign-off; they also asked us to check whether Redwood can accommodate a flat $5M cap for hosted services only.
- Order form: Net-45 is acceptable; please include proposed amendment language and final order form that includes billing milestones.

We attached our review notes (NovaTech_Review_Notes.pdf). If you can send a clean, consolidated PDF with the redline accepted and a short concession matrix, we can prepare the DocuSign routing. Also please include SOC 2 evidence link and primary contact for procurement to schedule an execution call.

DocuSign envelope requested: https://docusign.com/envelope/ABC123xyz
Drive link for redline: https://drive.google.com/redwood/nova-rfi-response

We'll hold our finance review until we see the final order form and concession matrix. Can you aim to send the consolidated response by EOD tomorrow (7/31)?

Regards,
Ellen Park

NovaTech Systems
